unchecked-cast-warning.title: unchecked cast warning
unchecked-cast-warning.short: Compiler cannot verify a generic cast
unchecked-cast-warning.summary: Casting from a raw type to a parameterized generic type can produce an unchecked warning.
unchecked-cast-warning.why: Ignoring it can hide a later ClassCastException.
tips: Prefer typed collections instead of raw types.
